pages: Anahera, ten, dark hair in a long plait, in a bright red swimsuit and blue shorts turns one flat brass key in the office door lock, the door swinging in on cold air. Middle distance: an open hardback log book on the desk, a wall clock. Background: the glass doors to the still deck, blue pre-dawn light.

Anahera, ten, dark hair in a long plait, in a bright red swimsuit and blue shorts leans over one open hardback log book on the desk by the office door, a pencil in her fist. Middle distance: the key on its nail, a wall clock. Background: the glass doors to the pool deck, thin early light.

Anahera, ten, dark hair in a long plait, in a bright red swimsuit and blue shorts kneels on the coping of the small pool with one hand pushed past her wrist into the water, a long-handled thermometer lying beside her knee. Middle distance: the pool steps, a folded blue towel. Background: the fence and grass, pale morning light.

Anahera, ten, dark hair in a long plait, in a bright red swimsuit and blue shorts pulls one steel pool gate towards her with both hands, the chain swinging slack. Middle distance: the small pool's flat cold water, a ladder rail. Background: the car park and low hedge, flat overcast light.

Anahera, ten, dark hair in a long plait, in a bright red swimsuit and blue shorts stands reading one sheet of paper pinned to the office wall, her hand flat under the line on it. Middle distance: the log book on the desk, a chair pushed back. Background: the plant room door, a red fire board. Cool morning light.

Anahera, ten, dark hair in a long plait, in a bright red swimsuit and blue shorts lowers one long-handled pool thermometer down into the deep end of the main pool, the handle going under. Middle distance: a round sensor bulb hanging on the poolside rail, the pool ladder. Background: open sky, water, hard morning sun.

Anahera, ten, dark hair in a long plait, in a bright red swimsuit and blue shorts stands on the pool steps doing a sum on her fingers, one pencil held between her lips. Middle distance: the spiral pad by the office door, the desk telephone. Background: the deck rail, flat midday light on the water.

A stocky man in orange work overalls kneels on the edge of the small pool, one white plastic box with a lid held against the leg of the shade sail, his hammer in the other hand. Middle distance: his boots set side by side, the bare rail. Background: the sail canvas, bright noon light.

Anahera, ten, dark hair in a long plait, in a bright red swimsuit and blue shorts writes in one open hardback log book on the office desk, the pencil point pressed hard on the ruled line. Middle distance: the long-handled thermometer lying across the desk, the shade sail leg. Background: the pool deck through the door, morning sun.

Anahera, ten, dark hair in a long plait, in a bright red swimsuit and blue shorts writes in the margin of one open hardback log book on the office desk, her forearm flat across the open book. Middle distance: the pool steps and the hanging rail, a stack of class sheets. Background: the deck and low sun.

Anahera, ten, dark hair in a long plait, in a bright red swimsuit and blue shorts lifts one long-handled pool thermometer out of the water, the wet column shining, the log book open on the coping beside her. Middle distance: the white box under the canvas, the rail. Background: the small pool, hot afternoon light.

Anahera, ten, dark hair in a long plait, in a bright red swimsuit and blue shorts stands on the pool steps with one hand on the bare rail clamp where the sensor used to hang. Middle distance: the white box nailed to the sail leg, the long handles leaning by the door. Background: the pool, late afternoon light.
